inquiry_drive_shadow.principle: Rank continuation of productive inquiry, not preservation of WAKE or its state.

review.alternative: Environmental feedback or external task instruction.
review.would_change_mind: Evidence of autonomous systems successfully optimizing complex objectives without intrinsic motivation or reward.

claims.statement: Intrinsic curiosity bootstraps exploration in environments with rare or deceptive rewards, supporting autonomous discovery.

support.explanation: Curiosity allows systems to initiate exploration when explicit external rewards are misleading.
support.passage: curiosity-driven learning enables organisms to make discoveries to solve complex problems with rare or deceptive rewards.

review.alternative: Non-convex optimization techniques exist but are not currently standard in the cited autonomous frameworks.
review.would_change_mind: Evidence of successful application of DICE-based methods to non-convex scalarization.

claims.statement: Optimization in autonomous systems often assumes convex scalarization functions, limiting efficacy in non-convex research landscapes.

support.explanation: Current methods for objective balancing are mathematically limited by convexity requirements.
support.passage: Our formulation assumes convexity, and thus the DICE-based approach relying on the Lagrangian dual does not apply to non-convex scalarization in MORL.

actions.findings:
Intrinsic curiosity bootstraps exploration in environments with rare or deceptive rewards, supporting autonomous discovery. [source-feb4fddb33664d63]

Optimization in autonomous systems often assumes convex scalarization functions, limiting efficacy in non-convex research landscapes. [source-4668e4bd26fe43c7]
actions.limitations: Current autonomous systems struggle with non-convex objective landscapes; reliance on simple scalarization limits the diversity and reliability of self-generated research questions.
actions.next_questions: How can autonomous agents dynamically learn or discover non-convex reward scalarization methods to better identify complex, research-worthy objectives?
actions.reason: Revision incorporating limitations of convex scalarization as a constraint on autonomous inquiry.
actions.summary: Autonomous open-ended discovery leverages intrinsic curiosity for bootstrapping exploration. However, current frameworks often rely on convex scalarization assumptions which may fail in complex, non-convex landscapes typical of real-world research problems. Incorporating non-convex constraint awareness is critical for robust problem identification.
actions.title: Integrating Autonomous Multi-Agent Frameworks and Curiosity-Driven Exploration for Open-Ended Discovery

proposal.summary: Progress on autonomous inquiry mechanisms by integrating non-convex constraint analysis into problem-formulation frameworks.
